faq.title: Frequently asked questions about our pet care
faq.intro: Helpful answers about drop-off, pick-up, updates and your pet’s stay in Dokkum.
faq.contactText: Feel free to send us a message. We would be happy to discuss the care your pet needs.

questions.question: How will we receive updates during our pet’s stay?
questions.answer: We send photos and videos via WhatsApp as standard. During day care, overnight stays and straight after a dog walk, you can see how your pet is doing.

questions.question: What are the opening hours for drop-off and pick-up?
questions.answer: We are open Monday to Sunday from 07:00 to 22:00. We agree on flexible drop-off and pick-up times with you in advance.

questions.question: Do the dogs stay in kennels or in your home?
questions.answer: Always in a homely setting. Our guests stay with us in our home and garden, with their own cushions, a bed and, if you wish, a cosy spot on the sofa for cuddles and rest.

questions.question: Do you look after cats too?
questions.answer: Yes, we also offer cat sitting in your own home in Dokkum. We visit your cats to provide fresh food and water, clean the litter tray and, of course, spend time cuddling and playing.

questions.question: Can we arrange a meeting beforehand?
questions.answer: Feel free to contact us to discuss an introductory meeting. This gives us time to get to know your pet, their routine and your wishes, and to discuss suitable care together.
